content.text: {"extract":[{"requirement_id":"R1","evidence":"Collaborate on annual marketing strategy, creative direction, brand development and stewardship, media planning, and cooperative marketing aligned with MCCVB priorities."},{"requirement_id":"R2","evidence":"Develop campaign concepts and final approved print, broadcast, digital, signage, collateral, and sales assets; follow MCCVB brand standards and coordinate production subcontractors as needed."},{"requirement_id":"R3","evidence":"Develop an integrated content-marketing plan using market intelligence, defined audiences and opportunities, objectives, tactics, workload-guiding actions, and measurable outcomes."},{"requirement_id":"R4","evidence":"Recommend media plans for leisure and group audiences, and potentially international markets, including budget allocation, market priorities, channel mix, partnerships, and emerging-media opportunities."},{"requirement_id":"R5","evidence":"Implement online and offline media plans, including buying, placement, optimization, cancellations, audits, vendor payments, and billing."},{"requirement_id":"R6","evidence":"Develop cooperative marketing programs that amplify member and stakeholder businesses while supporting MCCVB objectives."},{"requirement_id":"R7","evidence":"Provide monthly campaign and brand-continuity reporting and end-of-campaign reports with asset screenshots, goal dashboards, and qualitative and quantitative executive takeaways."},{"requirement_id":"R8","evidence":"Support customer-insight, creative-testing, and segmentation research as requested, sharing data, creative assets, and insights with MCCVB and research partners."},{"requirement_id":"R9","evidence":"Maintain account communications, provide an annual activity summary, attend necessary on-site meetings at agency expense, and coordinate with MCCVB marketing partners."},{"requirement_id":"R10","evidence":"Provide insertion budgets and payment/material deadlines before placements, and year-ahead cost estimates after the annual budget is supplied; obtain client approval before work begins."}]}
